title: Caro-Kann Defense: Two Knights Attack
line: White brings both knights out first; Black gives a bishop for a knight and builds the center.

steps.text: Here White brings both knights out and keeps the pawn in front of its queen at home.
Bring the bishop to g4. It pins the knight on f3 to White's queen.

also.d5e4: That also works. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.text: Take the knight. The bishop goes, but White loses a knight that watched the center.

wrong.g4h5: Many players keep the bishop this way. It costs time: White's pawns can chase it, and the engine prefers the trade.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 one square. Your pawns on the light squares make a solid center.
Take the pawn on e4. White's knight takes back, and your bishop can then come out and hit it.
Nothing guards White's pawn on d4 now. Take it with your queen.
steps.after: Black is a pawn up for now, and the queen stands in the center.

summary: Against the two knights, Black gives a bishop for a knight, builds the center and takes a pawn White left loose.
